facts.fact: The Office of the Head of the Local Government Service held two 2-day workshops, 13-14 July in Cape Coast and 16-17 July 2026 in Ho, training about 150 officers of Regional Co-ordinating Councils and participating Municipal Assemblies in six regions on the dLRev revenue management software.

The Office of the Head of the Local Government Service, a state body, runs the dLRev training and describes it as part of its capacity-building mandate, with the Head of Service urging Assemblies to adopt ICT revenue management (document published 2026-07-17).

The dLRev training was held under the Ghana Secondary Cities Support Programme, a World Bank-supported programme that covers revenue administration and computerisation in participating Municipal Assemblies.

systems.owner: Office of the Head of the Local Government Service
systems.tiers: participating Municipal Assemblies and Regional Co-ordinating Councils in Central, Western, Western North, Eastern, Volta and Oti regions (training); number of assemblies not stated
